Definition: Adajah, the name of eight Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Adaiah is the name of three men: the grandfather of Josiah the reforming king, a priest who backed Jehoiada when Joash was crowned, and a Benjamite in the genealogy of the tribe. Beyond these verses the Bible tells no more of them.
TheologicalSignificance: No doctrine hangs on any of the three. But the first of them sits close to a king who found the Book of the Law and tore his clothes over it — and I hold that as a reminder that reform often runs in families.
